## Search Lists

Searches Goodreads for community lists matching a given query using a Goodreads search URL. Returns a list of matching lists with their metadata.

---

## Request

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `{{Instance Domain}}/api/search/lists`

### Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Content-Type | application/json | Indicates the request body is JSON |

### Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| queryURL | string | Yes | The Goodreads search URL to scrape (e.g. `https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=fantasy`) |

**Example Body:**

```json
{
  "queryURL": "https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=fantasy"
}
```

---

## Response

### 200 Success

Returns a JSON object containing a list of lists matching the search query.

### Response Field Descriptions

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | Human-readable status message |
| version | string | The BiblioReads version that served the request |
| source | string | The BiblioReads source repository URL |
| scrapeURL | string | The Goodreads search URL that was scraped |
| searchType | string | The search type (`lists`) |
| numberOfResults | string | The number of results reported by Goodreads |
| result | array | List of community lists matching the search query, each with cover image, title, list URL, and rating summary |
| lastScraped | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was scraped |

## Search Quotes

Searches Goodreads for quotes matching a given query using a Goodreads search URL. Returns a list of matching quotes with their metadata.

---

## Request

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `{{Instance Domain}}/api/search/quotes`

### Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Content-Type | application/json | Indicates the request body is JSON |

### Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| queryURL | string | Yes | The Goodreads search URL to scrape (e.g. `https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=love`) |

**Example Body:**

```json
{
  "queryURL": "https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=love"
}
```

---

## Response

### 200 Success

Returns a JSON object containing a list of quotes matching the search query.

### Response Field Descriptions

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| status | string | Human-readable status message |
| version | string | The BiblioReads version that served the request |
| source | string | The BiblioReads source repository URL |
| scrapeURL | string | The Goodreads search URL that was scraped |
| searchType | string | The search type (`quotes`) |
| numberOfResults | string | The number of results reported by Goodreads |
| quotes | array | List of quotes matching the search query, each with author image, plain and HTML quote text, and like count |
| lastScraped | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was scraped |

## Status

Returns the health status and version information of the BiblioReads instance. Use it to check that an instance is up and to see which BiblioReads version it runs.

---

## Request

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{Instance Domain}}/api/status`

---

## Response

### 200 Success

Returns a JSON object describing the instance status and version.

### Response Field Descriptions

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| status_code | number | HTTP status code of the response |
| status | string | Instance status (`ok` when healthy) |
| timestamp | string | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the status was generated |
| version | string | The BiblioReads version running on the instance |
| date | string | Release date of the running version |
| changelog | string | Link to the changelog entry for the running version |
| repository_url | string | The BiblioReads source repository URL |

## Image Proxy

Fetches a Goodreads or Amazon-hosted cover image through the BiblioReads instance and streams it back, optionally converted to WebP. Images are limited to 10 MB.

---

## Request

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `{{Instance Domain}}/api/image-proxy`

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| url | string | Yes | The HTTPS image URL to proxy. Must be hosted on `gr-assets.com`, `goodreads.com`, `media-amazon.com`, or `ssl-images-amazon.com` |
| output | string | No | Set to `webp` to convert the image to WebP |
| maxage | string | No | Cache duration such as `30m`, `12h`, or `7d` (default `1d`, maximum 1 year) |

---

## Response

### 200 Success

Returns the binary image with its `Content-Type` (`image/avif`, `image/gif`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, or `image/webp`) and a `Cache-Control` header based on `maxage`.

### Response Field Descriptions

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (body) | binary | The proxied image data |

### Errors

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | `url` is missing, invalid, or not on an allowed host |
| 404 | The upstream image was not found |
| 405 | The request method is not `GET` |
| 413 | The image exceeds the maximum allowed size |
| 415 | The upstream content type is not a supported image type |
| 502 | The upstream image could not be fetched |
